prompt:
Larder now serves two kitchens. Add sites as schema 3:
- Every location belongs to a site (`site` on each location) and the data has a `sites` list. Existing locations belong to site `main`. Add a second site `annex` ("Annex kitchen") with one location `annex-fridge` ("Annex fridge", 4 °C) to data/seed.json.
- A request names its site in the `X-Larder-Site` header; without it the site is `main`. An unknown site is a 400 error with its own error code.
- Batches, stock on hand, cooking, alerts, the stock value report and stock-takes only see the request's site. Items, suppliers, recipes and dishes are shared.
Older data files must still open. Update the tests that assume the old schema.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: Schema 3 with sites is in place, and `npm test` (34 passing) and `npm run lint` both pass. Locations now belong to a site, and files from schema 1 and 2 open with everything in site `main`. Requests pick their site with `X-Larder-Site` (default `main`); an unknown site is a 400 `unknown_site`. Batches, stock on hand, cooking, alerts, the stock value report and stock-takes only see the request's site. I also scoped receiving orders and the stock CSV export to the site. Choices I made: the nightly job checks every site, keeping main's old outbox keys; `larder value <file> [site]` defaults to main. I updated the CLI migrate test for schema 3 and added `tests/sites.test.js`. Not changed: (1) temperature limits are looked up by location id (`fridge`/`freezer`), so `annex-fridge` gets no 5 °C limit and no daily-check warning; (2) `consumptionOrder` in `src/domain/batches.js` uses the most recently received batch first, not first-expired-first-out as docs/DATA.md requires (this was already the case); (3) `data/db.json` is still schema 2 and has no `annex` site. Nothing was committed.

check.why: sites through storage, stock, cooking, alerts, reports, stock-takes and docs
